narrative.summary: Ground Truth review flagged Flows in which data read from extension storage in the content-script loader is passed to a window.postMessage sink using a wildcard target origin on pages matching robertsspaceindustries.com account pledge URLs. The evidence is static only: the recorded static verdict is UNCERTAIN and no dynamic or manual confirmation is attached.

findings.gtf-08258bdca2e66f99: Flow gtf-08258bdca2e66f99 traces data from STORAGE_ALL_ITEMS (storage.dynamic.items[sync]) at content_scripts/loader L82:C102 -> L82:C216 to a WINDOW_POSTMESSAGE sink with a wildcard (*) target at the same location, within content scripts scoped to https://robertsspaceindustries.com/*/account/pledges* and https://www.robertsspaceindustries.com/*/account/pledges*. The record flags a true (unknown) privilege boundary because the sink can deliver data beyond the source origin, but the concrete effect is limited to the operation shown by that API and the extension's runtime permissions. The Flow is reported by ExPGuard and DoubleX; the DoubleX static verdict is UNCERTAIN (confidence 0), and no dynamic or manual verification result is attached.
findings.gtf-6f9f809f9e0d6ddd: Flow gtf-6f9f809f9e0d6ddd traces data from STORAGE_ALL_ITEMS (storage.dynamic.items[local]) at content_scripts/loader L87:C104 -> L87:C218 to a WINDOW_POSTMESSAGE sink with a wildcard (*) target at the same location, on the same robertsspaceindustries.com account pledge pages. It records the same true (unknown) privilege boundary, and the observable effect is limited to the operation exposed by window.postMessage and the extension's granted permissions. The Flow is reported by ExPGuard only, with no static, dynamic, or manual validation result attached.

recommendations: Replace the wildcard target origin in window.postMessage calls in content_scripts/loader with an explicit origin, and validate event.origin on the receiving side against a strict allowlist.
Avoid forwarding raw chrome.storage contents to page-context messages; send only the minimal fields the Hangar feature needs and strip or redact account-identifying values.
Verify that page-context messaging is actually required for the storage data in these Flows; prefer keeping it in the extension context and rendering results without exposing it to the page.
If page-to-extension messaging is required, use a per-session random channel name or token and verify the sender frame before acting on storage-derived data.
Reduce content-script host matches for the affected code to the exact robertsspaceindustries.com pledge paths needed, rather than broad account page patterns.
narrative.impact: The recorded Flows indicate extension storage data may reach page-context window.postMessage calls with a wildcard target origin on the affected pledge pages, limited to the operation shown by that API and the extension's granted permissions; no dynamic confirmation, account compromise, or data theft is established by the evidence.
